'''Ord Cantrell''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. It was originally an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] under the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] most exclusive resorts. During the early days of [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] exploration, it was settled by a [[Ord Cantrell Duros colony|colony]] of Duros that lost contact with the galaxy and reverted to simple technology before dying out.

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] [[Boat/Legends|sailing ship]] was dredged from the waters of Ord Cantrell.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Sailing into Fate}}</ref>

After the destruction of [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], Ord Cantrell's capital city of [[De-Purteen]] served as capital of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends#The "Council of Blood"|Imperial Interim Ruling Council]]. After the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] assassinated several members of the council, [[Xandel Carivus]] disbanded it and made himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] under the instructions of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] agent [[Nom Anor]].

Carivus also ordered the arrest of [[Feena D'Asta]], the daughter of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Ragez D'Asta]]&mdash;a pro-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] leader who controlled the largest privately owned [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In response, a furious Baron D'Asta used his fleet to [[Battle of Ord Cantrell|attack]] Ord Cantrell, forcing Emperor Carivus to plead for peace and to return his daughter safely. Later, the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Imperial Royal Guard]] [[Kir Kanos]] slew Carivus.

The planet was then taken under [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] control. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the world was conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong|invaders]].<ref name="TEA" />
